newsitem.title: USA: Complete Management, Amedisys to merge.
newsitem.headline: Complete Management, Amedisys to merge.

text.p: Complete Management Inc and Amedisys Inc on Thursday said they have signed a letter of intent to merge the two firms.
Complete, a physician practice management company, would pay $9.00 in CMI stock for each of the 2,583,864 outstanding shares of Amedisys, the company said.
The firms expected the merger to be settled in February 1997.

William F. Borne, chairman and chief executive of Amedisys, would join Complete's board of directors and the senior management of Amedisys would continue in the employ of the company after the merger.
Amedisys, a regional diversified health care company, is headquartered in Baton Rouge, La.
